definition: תְּהִלָּה noun feminine praise, song of praise (compare Arabic , the shouting of sacred formula; Sprenger Muhammad iii.527 We Skizzen iii.107 ff. 114. 117. 214 Nö ZMG 1887, 723 RS Semitic i. 411 Che OP 460 ) absolute ׳ ת Isa 60:18 + 19 t. + Jer 49:25 Kt , see ifrom; construct תְּהִלַּת Jer 48:2 + 2 t.; suffix תְּהִלָּתִי Jer 17:14 + 6 t.; תְּהִלָּתְךָ Deut 10:21 ; Ps 48:11 , תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 35:38 + 6 t.; תְּהִלָּתֶּיךָ Ps 9:15 ** on תְּהִדָמלָּ֫תֶיךָ Ps 9:15 as error for לָֹּ֫תֶךָ - or לֹּ֫תֶיךָ -, see Ol § 131 k; 39 c Sta § 354 b Hup Now and others on the passage . תְּהִלָּתוֺ Isa 42:10 + 10 t.; plural absolute תְּהִלֹּת Exod 15:11 construct תְּהִלּוֺת Ps 22:4 + 3 t.; — 1. praise, adoration, thanksgiving , paid to ׳ ֯ ׃י Ps 48:11 כשׁמך אלהים כן תהלתך לְ קצוי ארץ as thy name, O God, so is thy praise to the ends of the earth , Ps 111:10 תהלתו עמדת לעד , תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֺ בְּפִי Ps 34:2 continually is his praise in my mouth (|| ׳ אֲבָֽרֲכָה אֶתיֿ ) compare Ps 71:6 , also ימָּלֵא פִי תְהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 71:8 , ׳ פִּי יַגִּיד ת Ps 51:7 , תַּכַּעְנָה ׳ שְׂפָתַי ת Ps 119:17 1, ׳ יְדַבֶּר פִּ ׳ י ׳ ת Ps 145:21 (|| וִיבָרֵךְ כָּלֿ בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֺ ); as sung, song of praise יָשִׁירוּ תִּהִלָּתוֺ Ps 106:12 הַמְשֹׁרֲרִים וְשִׁירתְּֿהִלָּה וְהוֺדוֺת לֵאלֹהִים Neh 12:46 compare לֵאלֹהֵינוּ ׳ ת Ps 40:4 (appositive שֹׁיר הָדָשׁ ) & Isa 42:10 (appositive id. ), also ׳ לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה ת Isa 33:1 (|| ׳ רַנְנוּ צַדִּיקִים בי ); see perhaps Ps 148:14 ( Che ; yet see De VB ); note further אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי Ps 109:1 יוֺשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֺת יִשְׂרָאֵל Ps 22:4 inhabiting the praises of Israel ; וּמְרוֺמָם עַלכֶּֿלבְּֿרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה Neh 9:5 exalted above all blessing and praise ; compare also תְּהִלָּתִי Isa 48:9 (|| שְׁמִי ), & of praise due to ׳ י Isa 42:8 . 2. the act of general, public, praise (compare also above especially Ps 22:4 ; Ps 33:1 ; Ps 106:12 ; Neh 12:46 ); — בּאֹוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֺדָה ׳ חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּת Ps 100:4 enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise ; שִׁיר חָדָשׁ ׳ שִׁירוּ לי תְּהִלָּתוֺ בִּקְהִל חֲסִידִים Plalm Ps 149:1 compare Ps 22:26 ; Ps 65:2 ; Ps 66:2 ; Ps 147:1 before the army הֵחֵלּוּ בְרִנָּה וּתְחִלָּה 2Chr 20:22 in exhortation to the peoples הַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֺל תְּהִלָּתוֺ Ps 66:8 (|| בָּֽרֲכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ ), compare Isa 42:12 . 3. praise-song , as title, תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד Ps 145:1 (so Late Hebrew ספר תהלות & תְּהִלִּים , תִּילִּים , = Psalms ). 4. qualities, deeds, etc., of ׳ י , demanding praise: — נוֺרָא תְהִלֹּת Exod 15:11 (song), i.e. terrible in attributes that call for praise (|| נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ & עשֵֹׁה פֶלֶא ); often (both singular and plural) of Yahweh's deeds with verb סִפֵּר Ps 9:15 ; Ps 78:4 ; Ps 79:13 ; Isa 43:21 , also + ׳ שֵׁם י Ps 102:22 with יַשְׁמִיעַ Ps 106:2 (|| ׳ יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֺת י ); + צִדְקֶ֑ךָ with יֶהְגֶּה Ps 35:28 with יְבַשֵּׂ֑רוּ Isa 60:6 + ׳ חַסְדֵי י , with אַזְכִּיר Isa 63:7 vid also לְהֹדוֺת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 106:47 = 1Chr 16:35 to give thanks unto thy holy name, to glory in thy praises (= praiseworthy deeds). 5. renown, fame, glory: \ \ a. of Damascus עִיר תְּהִלָּ֑ה֯ Jer 49:25 (on Qr תְּהִלָּ֑ת see Hi Ges «GKC:80»§ 80 . 2 b); compare perhaps מַעֲטֵה תְהִלָּה Isa 61:3 mantle of renown (renown as a mantle , compare De VB ; > Di splendid garment ; but Bi Che Du read מַעֲטֵה אֵ֔בֶל and translate ׳ ת praise, song of praise , compare 1. 2 ). \ \ b. of ׳ י , מָֽלְאָה הָאָרֶץ ׳ כִּסָּה שָׁמַים הוֺדוֺ וּת Hab 3:3 his splendour hath covered (the) heavens, and of his renown the earth is full. Also \ \ c. figurative, praise, renown , = object of praise, possessor of renown; used \ \ \ ( a ) of Israel Deut 26:19 (absolute), Jer 13:11 (+ לִי ) Jer 33:9 (+ לִי and לְכֹל גּוֺיֵי הָאָרֶץ ) — all || שֵׁם , תִּפְאֶרֶת ; see also Isa 61:11 , & perhaps Ps 148:14 (see below 1 above); \ \ \ ( b ) of Jerusalem Isa 62:7 , also Zeph 3:19 ; Zeph 3:20 (both || שֵׁם ), all these with verb הָיָה or שִׂים ; compare וְקָרָאת ׳ יְשׁוּעָה חוֺמֹתַיִךְ וּשְׁעָרַיִךְ ת Isa 60:18 \ \ \ ( c ) of Babylon וַתִּתָּפֵשׂ תְּהִלַּת כָּלהָֿאָרֶץ Jer 51:41 \ \ \ ( d ) of Moab אֵין מוֺאָב ׳ עוֺד ת Jer 48:2 \ \ \ ( e ) of ׳ י , הוּא תְהִלָּֽתְךָ וְהוּא אֱלֹהֶיךָ Deut 10:21 , כִּי תְהִלָּתִי אָ֑תָּה Jer 17:14 (no verb)

תְּהִלָּה noun feminine praise, song of praise (compare Arabic , the shouting of sacred formula; SprengerMuhammad iii.527 WeSkizzen iii.107 ff. 114. 117. 214 NöZMG 1887, 723 RSSemitic i. 411 CheOP 460) absolute ׳ת Isa 60:18 + 19 t. + Jer 49:25 Kt, see ifrom; construct תְּהִלַּת Jer 48:2 + 2 t.; suffix תְּהִלָּתִי Jer 17:14 + 6 t.; תְּהִלָּתְךָ Deut 10:21; Ps 48:11, תְּהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 35:38 + 6 t.; תְּהִלָּתֶּיךָ Ps 9:15

**on תְּהִדָמלָּ֫תֶיךָ Ps 9:15 as error for לָֹּ֫תֶךָ- or לֹּ֫תֶיךָ-, see Ol§ 131 k; 39 c Sta§ 354 b Hup Now and others on the passage. תְּהִלָּתוֺ Isa 42:10 + 10 t.; plural absolute תְּהִלֹּת Exod 15:11 construct תְּהִלּוֺת Ps 22:4 + 3 t.; —
1. praise, adoration, thanksgiving, paid to ׳֯ ׃י Ps 48:11 כשׁמך אלהים כן תהלתך לְ קצוי ארץ as thy name, O God, so is thy praise to the ends of the earth, Ps 111:10 תהלתו עמדת לעד, תָּמִיד תְּהִלָּתוֺ בְּפִי Ps 34:2 continually is his praise in my mouth (|| ׳אֲבָֽרֲכָה אֶתיֿ) compare Ps 71:6, also ימָּלֵא פִי תְהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 71:8, ׳פִּי יַגִּיד ת Ps 51:7, תַּכַּעְנָה ׳שְׂפָתַי ת Ps 119:171, ׳יְדַבֶּר פִּ ׳י ׳ת Ps 145:21 (|| וִיבָרֵךְ כָּלֿ בָּשָׂר שֵׁם קָדְשׁוֺ); as sung, song of praise יָשִׁירוּ תִּהִלָּתוֺ Ps 106:12 הַמְשֹׁרֲרִים וְשִׁירתְּֿהִלָּה וְהוֺדוֺת לֵאלֹהִים Neh 12:46 compare לֵאלֹהֵינוּ ׳ת Ps 40:4 (appositive שֹׁיר הָדָשׁ) & Isa 42:10 (appositive id.), also ׳לַיְשָׁרִים נָאוָה ת Isa 33:1 (|| ׳רַנְנוּ צַדִּיקִים בי); see perhaps Ps 148:14 (Che; yet see De VB); note further אֱלֹהֵי תְהִלָּתִי Ps 109:1 יוֺשֵׁב תְּהִלּוֺת יִשְׂרָאֵל Ps 22:4 inhabiting the praises of Israel; וּמְרוֺמָם עַלכֶּֿלבְּֿרָכָה וּתְהִלָּה Neh 9:5 exalted above all blessing and praise; compare also תְּהִלָּתִי Isa 48:9 (|| שְׁמִי), & of praise due to ׳י Isa 42:8.
2. the act of general, public, praise (compare also above especially Ps 22:4; Ps 33:1; Ps 106:12; Neh 12:46); — בּאֹוּ שְׁעָרָיו בְּתוֺדָה ׳חֲצֵרֹתָיו בִּת Ps 100:4 enter his gates with thanksgiving, his courts with praise; שִׁיר חָדָשׁ ׳שִׁירוּ לי תְּהִלָּתוֺ בִּקְהִל חֲסִידִים Plalm Ps 149:1 compare Ps 22:26; Ps 65:2; Ps 66:2; Ps 147:1 before the army הֵחֵלּוּ בְרִנָּה וּתְחִלָּה 2Chr 20:22 in exhortation to the peoples הַשְׁמִיעוּ קוֺל תְּהִלָּתוֺ Ps 66:8 (|| בָּֽרֲכוּ עַמִּים אֱלֹהֵינוּ), compare Isa 42:12.
3. praise-song, as title, תְּהִלָּה לְדָוִד Ps 145:1 (so Late Hebrew ספר תהלות & תְּהִלִּים, תִּילִּים, = Psalms).
4. qualities, deeds, etc., of ׳י, demanding praise: — נוֺרָא תְהִלֹּת Exod 15:11 (song), i.e. terrible in attributes that call for praise (|| נֶאְדָּר בַּקֹּדֶשׁ & עשֵֹׁה פֶלֶא); often (both singular and plural) of Yahweh's deeds with verb סִפֵּר Ps 9:15; Ps 78:4; Ps 79:13; Isa 43:21, also + ׳שֵׁם י Ps 102:22 with יַשְׁמִיעַ Ps 106:2 (|| ׳יְמַלֵּל גְּבוּרוֺת י); + צִדְקֶ֑ךָ with יֶהְגֶּה Ps 35:28 with יְבַשֵּׂ֑רוּ Isa 60:6 + ׳חַסְדֵי י, with אַזְכִּיר Isa 63:7 vid also לְהֹדוֺת לְשֵׁם קָדְשֶׁ֑ךָ לְהִשְׁתַּבֵחַ בִּתְהִלָּתֶ֑ךָ Ps 106:47 = 1Chr 16:35 to give thanks unto thy holy name, to glory in thy praises (= praiseworthy deeds).
5. renown, fame, glory:
\ \ a. of Damascus עִיר תְּהִלָּ֑ה֯ Jer 49:25 (on Qr תְּהִלָּ֑ת see Hi Ges«GKC:80»§ 80. 2 b); compare perhaps מַעֲטֵה תְהִלָּה Isa 61:3 mantle of renown (renown as a mantle, compare De VB; > Di splendid garment; but Bi Che Du read מַעֲטֵה אֵ֔בֶל and translate ׳ת praise, song of praise, compare
1. 2).
\ \ b. of ׳י, מָֽלְאָה הָאָרֶץ ׳כִּסָּה שָׁמַים הוֺדוֺ וּת Hab 3:3 his splendour hath covered (the) heavens, and of his renown the earth is full. Also
\ \ c. figurative, praise, renown, = object of praise, possessor of renown; used
\ \ \ (a) of Israel Deut 26:19 (absolute), Jer 13:11 (+ לִי) Jer 33:9 (+ לִי and לְכֹל גּוֺיֵי הָאָרֶץ) — all || שֵׁם, תִּפְאֶרֶת; see also Isa 61:11, & perhaps Ps 148:14 (see below 1 above);
\ \ \ (b) of Jerusalem Isa 62:7, also Zeph 3:19; Zeph 3:20 (both || שֵׁם), all these with verb הָיָה or שִׂים; compare וְקָרָאת ׳יְשׁוּעָה חוֺמֹתַיִךְ וּשְׁעָרַיִךְ ת Isa 60:18
\ \ \ (c) of Babylon וַתִּתָּפֵשׂ תְּהִלַּת כָּלהָֿאָרֶץ Jer 51:41
\ \ \ (d) of Moab אֵין מוֺאָב ׳עוֺד ת Jer 48:2
\ \ \ (e) of ׳י, הוּא תְהִלָּֽתְךָ וְהוּא אֱלֹהֶיךָ Deut 10:21, כִּי תְהִלָּתִי אָ֑תָּה Jer 17:14 (no verb)
